c=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
print('dimensions',len(grid),set(map(len,grid)),'counts',c)
majority=c.most_common(1)[0][0]

print('output dimensions',len(out),set(map(len,out)),'colors',set(x for row in out for x in row))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
